def pass_route(n: int, edges: list[list[int]], stations: list[list[int]], prices: list[int]) -> int:
    import heapq

    zones = len(prices)
    graph = [[] for _ in range(n)]
    for u, v, cost, zone in edges:
        graph[u].append((v, cost, zone))
        graph[v].append((u, cost, zone))

    at_stop = [[] for _ in range(n)]
    for stop, zone in stations:
        at_stop[stop].append(zone)

    mask_count = 1 << zones
    inf = 10**18
    dist = [[inf] * mask_count for _ in range(n)]
    dist[0][0] = 0
    heap = [(0, 0, 0)]

    while heap:
        spent, stop, owned = heapq.heappop(heap)
        if spent != dist[stop][owned]:
            continue
        if stop == n - 1:
            return spent
        for zone in at_stop[stop]:
            bit = 1 << zone
            if owned & bit:
                continue
            next_owned = owned | bit
            next_spent = spent + prices[zone]
            if next_spent < dist[stop][next_owned]:
                dist[stop][next_owned] = next_spent
                heapq.heappush(heap, (next_spent, stop, next_owned))
        for nxt, cost, zone in graph[stop]:
            pay = cost
            if zone != -1 and (owned >> zone) & 1:
                pay = 0
            next_spent = spent + pay
            if next_spent < dist[nxt][owned]:
                dist[nxt][owned] = next_spent
                heapq.heappush(heap, (next_spent, nxt, owned))

    best = min(dist[n - 1])
    return best if best < inf else -1
